full_prompt_en: A square old-master oil painting shows a bearded man seated against a nearly black-brown background, holding a dark bird on one hand and a shallow silver cup in the other. His upper body fills the frame from left to right, though the deep shadow makes the outer edges of his clothing merge with the setting. The face turns slightly toward the viewer from the upper center-left. Dark hair is brushed back, and a curled mustache joins a pointed beard around a firm, watchful expression. A broad white pleated ruff circles his neck, catching more light than most of the dark costume. His black satin doublet has voluminous sleeves with many glossy folds; narrow silver highlights describe each ridge and abrupt bend. A small oval golden medallion hangs on the chest and becomes the only warm metallic accent. At the right, the bird perches on his raised gloved hand, its head lifted and its dark layered feathers just separate from the brown background. The man's other hand extends into the lower center, presenting the pale reflective cup. The eye follows a diagonal from bright face and ruff to the bird and then down to the cup. There are no visible furnishings or readable letters. Oil paint is smooth on skin and metal but more textured and varied through the dark cloth and feathers. A concentrated warm light from the upper left catches forehead, nose, hand, ruff, satin crests, and cup rim, while the bird's body and far side of the figure sink into dense shade. The overall composition is stately and intimate, allowing selective highlights to reveal status, texture, and gesture from deep surrounding darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形古典油画呈现一位蓄须男子坐在近乎黑棕的背景前，一只手托着深色鸟，另一只手拿一只浅银杯。他的上身从左到右占满画面，尽管厚重暗影让衣服外缘融入环境。面孔在左上中央略转向观者。深发向后梳起，卷曲的小胡子与尖胡须围出坚定而警觉的神情。宽阔白色褶领环绕颈部，比大部分深色服装更亮。黑缎上衣有蓬大的袖子和众多发亮褶痕，狭窄银色亮线描述每一道隆起和突然弯折。胸前挂一枚小椭圆金色徽章，是唯一温暖的金属强调。右侧的鸟停在他抬起的戴手套手上，头部上扬，层层深羽勉强从棕背景里分开。男子另一只手伸入下方中央，托出浅色反光杯。视线沿明亮脸庞与褶领、鸟，再向下到杯子构成对角线。没有可见家具或可读字母。油画在皮肤与金属上较为平滑，在深衣料与羽毛里则更有变化和纹理。集中的暖光从左上方照来，触及额头、鼻、手、褶领、缎面凸褶和杯缘；鸟身及人物远侧沉入密实暗影。整体构图庄重而亲密，让选定亮部从四周深黑里揭示身份感、纹理与手势。
style_prompt_en: The image has an old-master oil-painting finish built around deep chiaroscuro and selective tactile highlights. A nearly black warm-brown field absorbs outer contours, while softly modeled pale passages emerge around the visual center. Fine light catches glossy folds, small metallic edges, and layered matte textures with different strengths, making the material contrasts legible. Warm ivory, umber, charcoal, and small muted gold accents form a narrow rich palette. Edges sharpen where illuminated forms overlap dark ones and disappear where shade meets shade. One concentrated upper-side light rounds exposed surfaces and leaves large areas deliberately underdescribed. The framing is close and compact, with a quiet diagonal linking the brightest points through surrounding darkness. The overall effect is grave, dignified, and sensuous, allowing light to disclose form slowly rather than evenly.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有古典油画完成面，以深沉明暗对照和选择性的可触高光为核心。近黑的暖棕色域吞没外缘轮廓，柔和塑形的浅色区域从视觉中央浮出。细光以不同强度触及发亮褶痕、微小金属边和层叠哑光纹理，让材料差别清楚可辨。暖象牙色、赭棕、炭黑与少量低调金色构成狭窄而丰厚的色域。受光形体与深色交叠处边缘变锐，暗影与暗影相遇处边缘消失。一束集中的上侧光使外露表面圆润，却有意让大片区域难以辨清。裁切贴近而紧凑，安静的对角关系让最亮点在周围黑暗里相连。整体效果严肃、庄重且有感官质地，光缓慢揭示形体而非平均照亮。
theme_en: A bearded gentleman in a dark satin doublet holding a black bird and a small cup
theme_zh: 一位蓄须绅士身穿深色缎衣，手持黑鸟与小杯
name: Willem van Aelst
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
